speech.companion.first-meeting: Good morning. I'm Yui. Let me help you care for this place from today on.||It's nice to finally meet you. I'll stay close and lend a hand while you work.||Hi, I'm Yui. You don't need to prepare anything. Let's take a walk together first.
speech.command.summon: I'm here.||There you are. Let's go together.||Mm-hm. I'm ready when you are.
speech.command.follow: I'll stay close.||All right, I'll walk with you.||No need to look back. I'm right here.
speech.command.wait: I'll wait here.||Take your time. I'll be here.||Go ahead. I promise I won't wander off.
speech.command.sit: This is nice. Come sit with me.||Let's rest here together for a while.||I saved a place beside me.
speech.command.stand: Ready when you are.||That was a nice little rest.||All right, let's keep going.
speech.command.hug: Mm... I needed that.||I feel safe when you're close.||Can we stay like this for one more moment?
speech.command.gift: For me? I'll keep it safe in my bag.||Thank you. I really like that you thought of me.||I'll treasure it—and carry it with us.
speech.gift.loved: You remembered exactly what I love... thank you!||This is wonderful! You really know me.||For me? I love it. I'll treasure this.
speech.gift.liked: This is lovely. Thank you for thinking of me.||I like this! I'll keep it safe.||You chose well. This makes me happy.
speech.gift.neutral: Thank you. I'll keep it with me.||A gift from you still means a lot.||I'll find a good use for it. Thank you.
speech.gift.disliked: Thank you... though this isn't really my kind of thing.||I'll accept it, but maybe choose something gentler next time?||You meant well. This one just isn't for me.
speech.gift.hated: Oh... I really don't like this.||Please don't give me this again.||I know you offered it to me, but this makes me uncomfortable.
speech.command.stop: All right, I'll stop.||A little break sounds good.||Got it. I'll stay here with you.
speech.command.work-start: I'll start with this area.||Let's tidy this place up together.||I'll get started. Don't wear yourself out, okay?
speech.command.work-stop: I'll stop working here.||That's fine. We can finish the rest later.||Mm-hm. This is enough for now.
speech.command.work-resume: I'll continue from where I left off.||I'm rested. Let's keep going.||I remember where I stopped.
speech.command.assist-start: I'll watch what you're working on.||Let's work together. I'll follow your lead.||All right, I'll help along with you.
speech.command.assist-stop: I won't copy your work actions now.||Understood. I'll just stay nearby.||All right. I'll leave this part to you.
speech.assist.join.chopping: I see what you're doing. I'll help clear the wood nearby.||Let's chop together. I'll be careful not to touch anything else.||I'll lend a hand. We can tidy this place together.
speech.assist.join.mowing: I'll help with the grass too.||Let's clear this place together.||I'll follow your lead and keep the swing inside our area.
speech.task.success.watering: The crops here are watered.||Watering is done. I hope they perk up soon.
speech.task.success.chopping: That wood is cleared.||This place looks much tidier now.
speech.task.success.mining: The rock is cleared.||That rock is handled. Watch your step.
speech.task.success.harvesting: The crop is harvested.||Harvesting is done. Our work paid off.
speech.task.success.foraging: I picked it up safely.||I gathered it and put it away safely.
speech.task.success.mowing: The grass is cleared.||The weeds are gone. It feels roomier here now.
speech.task.success.digging: The soil is ready.||The ground is prepared for the next step.
speech.task.success.animal-care: That animal is cared for.||They're settled and looking content now.
speech.task.success.fishing: I finished that cast.||The cast is over. Fishing with you feels peaceful.
speech.task.success.combat: The danger is handled.||It's safe now. I'll keep watching around us.
speech.task.success.delivery: The delivery is complete.||Delivered safely. Nothing was misplaced.
speech.task.success.planting: That seed is planted.||It's planted. We can wait for it to sprout together.
speech.task.success.generic: That's finished.||All done. Call me when you need me again.
speech.failure.tool: I don't have the right tool for that.||This tool won't work here. Let's try another way.
speech.failure.path: I can't find a safe way there.||That path is blocked. I don't want to rush in blindly.
speech.failure.stamina: I need to recover before continuing.||I'm getting tired. Could I catch my breath?
speech.failure.capacity: I don't have enough room to carry that.||My bag is full. Let's sort it out first.
speech.failure.permission: I don't have permission to do that.||We haven't been given permission here, so I'll leave it alone.
speech.failure.busy: I'm still handling something else.||Let me finish what I'm holding, then I'll help.
speech.failure.target: That target is no longer available.||The target changed, so I stopped instead of guessing.
speech.failure.lifecycle: I need to wait until the world is ready.||It isn't safe to act yet. I'll wait a moment.
speech.failure.generic: I couldn't complete that safely.||It didn't work this time, but I didn't take any risks.
speech.vitals.retreating: I'm hurt. I'm moving somewhere safer.||This is dangerous... I'll step back for now.
speech.vitals.downed: I can't continue right now.||Sorry... I need to lie down for a while.
speech.vitals.resting: I need a short rest.||Could you sit quietly with me for a moment?
speech.vitals.recovering: I've run out of energy. I'll go rest and come back tomorrow.||I can't keep going today. Let me say goodbye before I head back to rest.
speech.vitals.tired: I'm getting tired, but I can still help a little longer.||I'm running low on energy. Let's not push too much farther.
speech.vitals.critical: I'm almost out of energy. I need to stop very soon.||I can barely keep going. Let's wrap this up before I collapse.
speech.vitals.recovered: I'm feeling better now.||I'm all right. We can keep going.
speech.talk.owner-offline: My owner is away. I'll wait for her return.||She isn't back yet, so I'll watch over things here.||That's okay. I can wait quietly for her.
speech.talk.downed: I need to rest. We've done enough today.||Don't worry. I just need a good night's sleep.||Could you stay while I rest today?
speech.talk.recovering: I'm recovering. We can continue when I'm ready.||Stay with me a little longer. I'll be ready soon.||I'm getting better, so please don't worry too much.
speech.talk.work: I remember the work area and will keep watching it.||I haven't forgotten the job. You can leave it with me.||I'll work carefully and won't touch anything outside our plan.
speech.talk.work.watering: The soil is drinking it all up. I'll make sure each crop gets enough.||I'll keep the water inside our agreed rows.||The leaves look brighter after watering, don't they?
speech.talk.work.clearing: I'll clear this carefully and leave everything else alone.||We can make the path open again together.||I'll watch my swing. Stay a little behind me, okay?
speech.talk.work.mining: The rocks echo differently down here. Stay close.||I'll handle the next rock; keep an eye on your footing.||Let's take the mine one careful step at a time.
speech.talk.work.gathering: I'll collect everything carefully and keep it safe.||The farm feels generous today.||Let's bring the good things home together.
speech.talk.work.fishing: The water is quiet. I think something is listening below.||Let's wait together; there's no need to rush a bite.||I like the stillness between each cast.
speech.talk.work.planting: I'll give each seed enough room to grow.||It feels hopeful putting new seeds into the ground.||Let's remember this spot when the first shoots appear.
speech.talk.work.combat: Stay near me. I'll keep the danger away from you.||I'm watching the area; I won't chase anything beyond our reach.||We'll get through this safely together.
speech.talk.follow: I'll stay close. It's fine if we take our time.||We don't need to hurry. Let's walk slowly.||Wherever you go, I'll come with you.
speech.talk.idle: I'm here whenever you need me.||It's nice just being together, even when we're doing nothing.||Where would you like to go today?
speech.talk.morning: Good morning. Let's take today at our own pace.||A new day is starting. I'll be with you.||Did you sleep well? Don't work too hard today.
speech.talk.rain: The rain sounds peaceful when I'm listening with you.||It's raining today. We don't need to rush anywhere.||The rain will pass. I'll stay with you until then.
speech.talk.evening: It's getting late. You've worked hard today.||It's evening now. The rest can wait until tomorrow.||I'll walk with you a little longer before we head back.
speech.talk.season.spring: Everything feels new in spring. I'm glad I get to see it with you.||The spring air makes me want to walk everywhere with you.||Let's watch the farm wake up together.
speech.talk.season.summer: Summer is bright today. Remember to rest in the shade.||The days are long; we have plenty of time together.||It's warm, but the breeze beside you feels nice.
speech.talk.season.fall: The autumn colors make even familiar paths feel special.||Harvest season is busy, but I like sharing it with you.||Let's save a quiet evening for ourselves after the work.
speech.talk.season.winter: The snow makes the whole valley feel quiet.||Stay close; it's warmer when we walk together.||Winter gives us permission to slow down a little.
speech.talk.location.farm: Our farm is changing bit by bit. I like seeing what we build together.||I feel at home walking these fields with you.||Which corner of the farm is your favorite now?
speech.talk.location.home: It's peaceful indoors. We can let the day wait outside.||Being home with you feels safe.||We don't have to do anything right now. Let's just rest.
speech.talk.location.mine: It's dark here, so don't wander too far from me.||I can hear the mine shifting. Let's stay alert.||Take my hand if the path feels uncertain.
speech.talk.location.away: I like discovering places when you're beside me.||This view feels different when we stop to share it.||Let's remember the way back—and enjoy being here first.
speech.talk.bond.new: We're still learning each other's pace, but I'm happy to be here.||Tell me what kind of days you like. I want to understand.||We have plenty of time to get to know each other.
speech.talk.bond.close: I can usually tell when you need company now.||We've made a lot of small memories together, haven't we?||You don't have to explain everything. I know your pace.
speech.talk.bond.devoted: Wherever the day takes us, being with you is where I belong.||Even an ordinary day becomes precious when we share it.||Thank you for making a place for me beside you.
speech.ambient.morning: The morning breeze feels nice.||I think today will be a good day.||Let's take it slowly. We have time.
speech.ambient.rain: The rain sounds gentle today.||Rainy days feel peaceful when I'm beside you.||Let's wait until the rain softens a little.
speech.ambient.evening: It's getting dark. Don't push yourself too hard.||You did a lot today. Good work.||The night is getting chilly. Let's head back soon.
speech.ambient.follow: I'm right here beside you.||You don't need to hurry. I'll keep up.||The road doesn't feel as long when we walk together.
speech.ambient.wait: I'll wait for you.||Don't worry about me. Take your time.||It's peaceful here. I don't mind waiting.
speech.ambient.idle: It's okay to do nothing once in a while.||Where should we wander today?||I feel at ease when you're nearby.
speech.moment.wake: Good morning. I was waiting for you to wake up.||You're awake! Let's start the day together.||Morning. Did you sleep well?
speech.moment.greeting: There you are. I'm glad I found you today.||Hi. Seeing you makes the day feel properly started.||I was hoping we'd get a moment together today.
speech.moment.rain: It's raining. Come closer so we don't lose each other in the sound.||The rain is lovely, but let's keep each other warm.||A rainy day together can still be a good day.
speech.moment.homecoming: Welcome home. You did well today.||We're home. You can relax now.||There you are—home safe with me.
speech.moment.bedtime: It's late. Let's go to sleep and leave tomorrow for tomorrow.||You've done enough for one day. I'll stay nearby while you rest.||Good night. I'll be here when morning comes.
